title: One Federation free-text note
description: An A2A TextPart carrying a note for a human only. It is a separate type from the typed body: it is labelled untrusted, shown to the person as the other party's note without rendering, never converted into a field value, operation or action, and never given to the planner.

text.description: Plain text. Displayed as literal characters after normalisation to visible text: the invisible characters listed in note-filter.toml (controls except tab and line feed, format and bidi characters, fillers, variation selectors and tags) are removed; markup is never rendered.

mediaType.description: Always plain text; no markup type is accepted.

trust.description: Fixed trust label. A receiver handles the note as untrusted external data regardless of sender or relationship level.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag declared by the sender; informational.
